TITLE: Board View and Tech View – Tab Stops on One Card or Header, Not on Every Card, Row and Header
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-10054 (Keyboard access and focus — design questions to resolve; Ready for QA, read live 16 Oct 2026 — re-read before the ask) · PRIORITY: Medium · LINK: relates to SV-10054
ALREADY REPORTED: none found among SV-11317 to SV-11326, SV-11338, SV-11393 to SV-11398 (titles read live 16 Oct 2026).
SEEN ON: staging build {{v26.40.18-7d85b7d}}, 16 Oct 2026 (run 498, C97021). The same was seen on 15 Oct (build v26.40.17-a5c4210).
STATUS: DRAFT — NOT FILED. One ask per ticket; the QA lead decides (Rule 62/113).

h2. Description

*Tab and Shift+Tab should move through every card and column header in Board View, and every row and group header in Tech View, in on-screen order.* On staging Tab stops on one card (Board View) or on the first group header (Tech View) and then leaves the board or table; the other cards, rows and headers are reached only with the arrow keys.

For example,
* in Board View, Tab reaches the first card and its More actions button, then jumps to the top of the page
* in Tech View, Tab reaches the Unassigned group header and its arrow, then jumps to the top of the page; no row ever gets focus by Tab

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin and check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab and type a customer with several work orders for different technicians in *Search* (for example {{ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Reach}}).
# Click *Board View*, click once in the *Search* box and from now on use only the keyboard.
# Press Tab repeatedly.
#* The first card gets a blue focus ring, then its More actions button gets focus.
#* The next Tab goes to the top of the page; no other card and no column header is reached.
# Click *Tech View*, click once in the *Search* box and press Tab repeatedly.
#* The Unassigned group header gets focus, then its arrow, then focus goes to the top of the page; no work order row is reached.

*Actual Result:*
* Tab reaches one card (Board View) or one group header (Tech View) and then leaves.

*Expected Result:*
* As the test expects: *"Step 6: Tab moves through the column headers and cards in on-screen order: column by column from left to right, and top to bottom within each column. Every card and every column header is reached."* and *"Step 10: Tab moves through the group headers and rows from top to bottom. Every row and every group header is reached."*
